cold_successor_rule: A successor reads this locator, resolves current canonical state, and either executes the declared action if authorized or replaces it with a newly justified action after reconciliation.
one_baton_law: At the end of a work cycle there must be exactly one highest-value executable next action.
purpose: The next-action locator contract: the one-baton law, the fields a next action must state, the selection rule, and how a cold successor treats a declared action.
selection_rule: Prefer the smallest causal unit that advances the North Star and reduces uncertainty; do not create another framework when an existing seam can be verified or repaired.
title: CURRENT REALITY / NEXT ACTION
